name: Xcode agentic coding
desc: Coding agents such as Claude Agent and Codex working inside Xcode.
desc_zh: Claude Agent、Codex 等编码智能体直接在苹果 Xcode 内工作。
solves: Switching to another editor to use an agent breaks your flow; Xcode now hosts the agent beside your project.
solves_zh: 为了用智能体而换编辑器会打断节奏；现在 Xcode 让智能体就守在项目旁边。
best_for: You are deep in an Xcode project and want an agent to take a complex task without leaving the IDE.
best_for_zh: 正埋头在 Xcode 工程里，想让智能体接手一个复杂任务又不想离开 IDE 时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Apple Newsroom archive）。 Missing from the ledger. First shipped in Xcode 26.3 on 2026-02-03 with Claude Agent and Codex; Xcode 27 extended it on 2026-06-08 with new APIs for integrating AI models and more agentic coding. Recorded as an in-product surface of Xcode rather than a new Apple product. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/02/xcode-26-point-3-unlocks-the-power-of-agentic-coding/
